items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I saw Fess Williams. He could have probably told me.

ctx.x: That's alright. I wonder what happened to Guy? You don't know what happened to Wilton Krala?
No, not now. I've forgotten. Should I ask in New York? I saw Fess Williams. He could have probably told me.
dear I don't know. I don't know. Have you gotten a book?
